statement: Gilded Sword is the first Tab 1 priority because it boosts damage dealt to all monsters
Sharpened Axe is second because it adds to base Weapon Power which matters at any point in the game
Third priority is 50 points in Idle Casting for AFK gain rates while fighting
Idle Casting has diminishing returns; 100 points gives only 17% so stop prioritizing after 50 points
Overclocked Energy is next as it is a main damage source for all Mages including Shaman and Wizard
Mana Booster comes after Overclocked Energy since more Mana means more damage

subsystem: tab 1 Book of the Wise|Quickness Boots
statement: After that choose Book of the Wise for Wisdom damage or Quickness Boots for Agility accuracy depending on need
If you lack Accuracy for the monsters you fight all other stats are useless so always have enough Accuracy
Return to Tab 1 at the end of the build since Tab 3 talents boost Book of the Wise further
Power Overwhelming is always the first Tab 2 priority; it increases the effect of Weapon Power on damage
Knowledge is Power (damage from Wisdom) and Mana Overdrive (percent max Mana) are equal next priorities
Mana Overdrive gives percentage-based max Mana which scales up and makes Overclocked Energy more valuable
Active attack skills give a damage boost and a hidden multiplier on kills per hour while AFK or offline on set attack skills
For the Wizard the hidden AFK kills-per-hour multiplier is on Mini Fireball on this page
Energy Bolt gives some extra damage but priority should really go into Mini Fireball
Put about 10 points in Energy Bolt and 40-50 in Mini Fireball to get full hidden multiplier and damage
Choose Unt'WIS'ted Robes if you have enough Wisdom on gear otherwise Individual Insight for base Wisdom; Robes first if gear is high enough
Unt'WIS'ted Robes scaling is very good for Mage classes
After Robes put points into Individual Insight for more base Wisdom; rest is optional
He puts a few points in Choppin' It Up EZ for a small damage boost based on highest Chopping minigame score; scaling is bad
Would go up to 50 points in Choppin' It Up EZ; a bit more is available from Tab 3
You're Next gives a little extra damage when actively playing but is not worth points on an AFK character
Free Meal reduces food consumed while fighting monsters
Tab 3 priority starts with Paperwork Great which boosts damage based on number of Stamps collected and scales very well
Paperwork Great gives 41% damage for every 10 Stamps owned
Wiz Wumbo is the next priority as it allows more points into Book of the Wise on Tab 1
Next assign attack talents Ice Shards; Floor is Lava; Tornado; Mana is Life which all give the hidden AFK kill multiplier
Recommends about 20 points into each of Ice Shards; Floor is Lava; Tornado and Mana is Life
If using the character actively invest a few more points in attack skills as their damage scales nicely on Wizard
Fuscia Flasks raises max level of Overclocked Energy based on level of the Mage is Best bubble in Alchemy
With about 33 in Mage is Best bubble Fuscia Flasks lifts Overclocked Energy from base level 100 to 133
Gimmick: you can reset talents and the bonus Overclocked Energy levels stay even without points in Fuscia Flask
Fuscia Flasks can be put in a second tab preset and it will also affect your first preset
Everything else is optional; extra points can go to Earlier Education for more utility from your other tab
Staring Statues is basically useless as its only benefit is to secondary skills
Occult Obols is not very good; with about 20 Wisdom from Obols it only adds 75% more than listed
Nearby Outlet is better than Obols as it increases Charge Rate so you collect souls more often
Put points in Nearby Outlet and dump any leftover into Occult Obols for a small damage boost
After Tab 3 go back to Tab 1 and add more points to Book of the Wise for another large damage boost
With leftover points first max out Idle Casting for a little more benefit
Next choose Farsight for crit chance and crit damage or Lucky Clover for drop rate and EXP gain
Last option is Fist of Rage for max HP and crit damage

subsystem: star talents Will of the Eldest|Beginner Best Class
statement: First star talent priority is Will of the Eldest and Beginner Best Class at about 20 points each as classes are just under level 200

subsystem: star talents Will of the Eldest|Beginner Best Class
statement: If your classes are lower level put fewer points in these since they cap based on highest class levels
Next put points into Attacks on Simmer and Tick-Tock for more AFK gains

subsystem: star talents Goblet of the Hemoglobin
statement: Goblet of the Hemoglobin helps survivability and reduces food consumption
Stonks gives more free Star Talent Points; he has not unlocked it
Put 30 points into Stonks to get 48 star talent points back; over 30 is not useful
Dungeonic Damage is the first Tab 2 star priority; one of the largest damage boosts based on Dungeon Credits earned; max it
Frothy Malk is next for getting more out of foods and potions

subsystem: star talents Telekinetic Storage|Printer Sampling|Shrine Architect
statement: Optional: Telekinetic Storage for carry capacity and one point each in Printer Sampling and Shrine Architect
Mega Crit from Flurbo Shop boosts crit chance and gives Mega Crits if you have over 100% crit chance
Just EXP gives more Class EXP while farming on this character
Lower level characters may like Pulsation to regen Mana faster and use active attacks more often
Cardiovascular increases Card Drop Chance
Assign all active abilities from Tab 2 and Tab 3 to the Attack Bar or they are not used offline
When playing actively the order of abilities matters as the game uses the first attack slot first then the second
Put Mini Fireball up front and Energy Bolt later so more damaging attacks are used first
Reset talents easily with Star Talent Reset fragments that drop from monsters throughout the game
Reset fragments can also be bought from shops and instantly reset all Talent Points for reassignment
Star Talent Reset Potion lets you reassign all Star Talents if you make a mistake
